prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Niobium (Nb) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a mint vault of stacked gold bars, trays of fresh coins and a heavy steel door, warm lamplight on the metal
Hair: her hair tied up in a loose bun or ponytail — same colour and length as the attached image, a few strands loose.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a mechanic's coverall with its top half peeled down and the sleeves tied at the waist over a fitted cropped tank top, work boots — in a soft pastel palette such as powder pink, baby blue, mint or lavender; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 80-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 60-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque; right now — she has slipped her outer layer off and tied it around her waist by its sleeves, leaving only the fitted inner top over her bare shoulders and arms, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
SUPPORT: her back rests against the seat back.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera at her eye level; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on her knee — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with her own right hand she sets a cup down on the surface in front of her; it is all she holds.
LEGS: legs crossed at the knee.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: level lowered brow, steady unblinking eyes, mouth closed in a straight line, jaw set.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — niobium: a soft, grey, ductile metal first found in 1801 in a heavy black stone from New England kept in a London museum and called columbium; long thought the same as tantalum, it was split from it in 1844 and named for Niobe, daughter of Tantalus, who wept for her fourteen lost children until she turned to a stone that still weeps on a mountainside; an electric current grows a thin oxide on it that shines blue, violet, gold or green by its thickness, used for body jewellery; cooled near absolute zero it carries current without resistance in the great superconducting magnets of scanners and particle accelerators — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: petite, small-framed — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
